name: Supply Chain Compromise
summary: Adversaries may perform supply chain compromise to gain control systems environment access by means of infected products, software, and workflows. Supply chain compromise is the manipulation of products, such as devices or software, or their delivery mechanisms before receipt by the end consumer. analytics.name: Analytic 1863
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a vendor-distributed software update package that, upon execution, exhibits behavior inconsistent with the vendor's documented installation profile: spawning unexpected child processes, writing files outside the vendor's standard manifest, or loading unsigned Dynamic Link Libraries (DLLs). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2109
analytics.guidance: Periodic or event-triggered integrity verification identifies field devices with firmware or configuration that differs from the vendor-published authorized baseline, detected by comparing device firmware hashes against the authorized firmware inventory, appearing immediately after a vendor-supplied update or hardware replacement. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.…

analytics.name: Analytic 2111
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor software package whose installation, via package manager, creates unexpected files or starts unrecognized services not documented in the vendor's package manifest. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2189
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a network infrastructure device exhibiting behavioral anomalies (unexpected listening ports, new routing entries) after a vendor firmware update or hardware replacement, where the device firmware hash does not match the authorized inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
